[[Carnotaurus]] is a large, [[extinct]] carnivorous dinosaur from the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cretaceous Cretaceous] period, found in temperate and tropical [[shrubland|shrublands]]. It is known for its extremely short arms(even shorter than most other theropods) and the horns it has over its eyes. Like with all real-world extinct creatures, its spawning depends on settings chosen during world creation.

Carnotaurus can be extremely dangerous due to its powerful bite. Nevertheless, these can be extremely beneficial to a fortress when captured and tamed. Carnotaurus has a high [[pet]] value of 400. It has very high clutch sizes and butcher yields(with an added [[gizzard stone]] as seen in the raws). They can also be trained for war or hunting. They have the MOUNT_EXOTIC tag which implies the ability for [[elves]] to bring them as war animals during [[siege]]s. A baby Carnotaurus is called a ''hatchling.''

Some [[dwarves]] [[like]] Carnotaurus for their ''eye horns''.
